title: Chapter 258 Ni Wu Escapes Again
content:
Chapter 258 Ni Wu Escapes Again

Many lords who had thought of taking advantage of the situation were frightened and gave up the idea of being enemies with Wang Shuo.

Before, they only knew that Wang Shuo was the number one in Changping County, and they were somewhat dissatisfied.

Now, they all obeyed!

This person can only be made friends, not enemies!

But Wang Shuo frowned at this time, and had a bad premonition in his heart.

After waiting for a long time, there was no system prompt.

Could it be that this guy also has a resurrection item?

Wang Shuo was not wrong. Lin Guanru gave Wutuk a resurrection coin just in case.

Wutuk, who was resurrected in Nanshanji, burst into a shocking roar!

He was dissatisfied!

Lin Guanru heard Wutuk's roar, his heart sank, and he guessed that the war was not going well.

He walked quickly towards Wutuk.

"Mr. Mayor, I am defeated!" Wutuk knelt on one knee and apologized to Lin Guanru.

Hearing this news, Lin Guanru was so scared that his legs went weak, and he couldn't believe his ears.

...

On the battlefield, with the disappearance of Wutuk.

The army of Nanshanji seemed to have lost its backbone, and countless gang members stopped attacking and began to retreat slowly.

The guards were also a little overwhelmed and confused at this time.

The leader of a small gang immediately ordered a retreat.

This move was like a fuse, and the army of Nanshanji retreated to the distance like a tide.

"Surrender and no killing!"

Wang Shuo saw this and immediately shouted.

"Surrender and no killing!"

...

The shouts of Wana Village shook the four fields!

But no one stopped.

"All troops attack!"

The Alliance Army finally felt a sense of participation, and was more passionate than Wang Shuo's Chiyan Army.

At this time, Guan Jie sent a message, which made Wang Shuo frown.

"Ni Wu, leading people to retreat!"

This old guy actually slipped away!

That won't do!

Wang Shuo didn't want to miss this good opportunity.

So they could only let the infantry go and chase the fleeing Nanshanji army.

"Yuanjie, the next pursuit mission will be under your command. Capture as many enemies as possible."

"Yes, Lord."

After the instructions, Wang Shuo and the cavalry troops of Ayub and Gude went to chase Ni Wu.

Ni Wu never thought that he would be discovered by Wang Shuo even when he was invisible.

After seeing Wang Shuo "kill" Utuk, he was also unbelievable.

Although he was arrogant, he still knew his own limitations. At this time, it was almost impossible for him to defeat Wang Shuo with his few men.

He could only leave temporarily and try to make a comeback!

Hearing the rumbling sound of horse hooves, he no longer cared about hiding. In the invisible state, their speed of movement was limited.

"The people from Wana Village are coming, everyone run away!"

I don't know who shouted, and the gang members of Tiejianmen no longer cared about anything and ran wildly!

But no matter how fast they were, they couldn't outrun the war horses!

Wang Shuo was not in a hurry. As long as the group of people were exhausted, it would be the best time to attack.

Just when everyone was about to run to the exit of the valley, Zhang Yang arrived with his men and completed the siege.

"Ni Wu, why don't you surrender quickly!" Wang Shuo saw that the other party had no way to go, and laughed heartily.

"Hmph, Wang Shuo, don't be complacent! Today's revenge will be repaid in the future!"

After that, Ni Wu directly took out a random teleportation scroll.

Wang Shuo's pupils shrank, and he could not stop it. He could only watch Ni Wu escape.

At this moment, he suddenly hated these props in the game.

After capturing these people, Zhang Yang rode over on horseback.

"I didn't expect you to come!" Wang Shuo was very grateful.

"I came here this time to sell you a favor. Next time I am in danger, you can't just watch me die!" Zhang Yang smiled pretending to be serious.

"Haha, of course."

"Now is not the time to reminisce, the battle is not over yet!"

After saying that, he returned to the main battlefield.
